items.reason: The claimed webhook feedback loop is absent: inbound status sync calls update_group_status (src/sentry/integrations/tasks/sync_status_inbound.py:220,247), which bulk-updates groups and records activity without scheduling outbound synchronization (src/sentry/models/group.py:461-470). The added parameter is unused on an abstract method (src/sentry/integrations/mixins/issues.py:410-422), while the existing outbound status task remains unchanged; this does not introduce the alleged looping behavior.
